description: This file defines the Notification class, which models the <notification> element in the configuration, containing attributes like subject, screen, and service with validation logic.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: An immutable, thread-safe class representing a notification configuration element with attributes for subject, screen, and service.

methods.name: Notification
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a Notification object from an XML Element, with validation for required attributes.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the screen attribute associated with the notification.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Returns the service attribute associated with the notification.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject attribute associated with the notification.
